title: Gohxnz drops a recent single titled "All Star"
htmlContent:
American-based hip hop star Gohxnz is a multi-talented rapper and lyrical intellectual currently creating a name for himself with his recent song "All-star." Gohxnz was raised in the music scene at an exceptionally youthful age but started bringing it seriously in 2020.

Gohxnz, on his recent track "All-Star," is a beautiful track with a vocal arrangement packed with his signature swagger full of confidence, with his fantastic presentation of emceeing that creates his presence felt on this jam.
